Project Overview
Tandob is an automated meeting intelligence platform designed to bridge the gap between live video communication and actionable text data. By leveraging Zoom Webhooks and OAuth 2.0 authentication, the system creates a hands-free pipeline that detects the completion of cloud recordings and instantly extracts high-fidelity meeting transcripts.

Core Functionalities
Real-time Event Detection: Utilizes a secure Node.js webhook listener with HMAC SHA256 signature verification to monitor Zoom meeting lifecycles.

Automated Transcript Extraction: Automatically identifies and captures .VTT (Virtual Video Text) files from Zoom’s cloud storage immediately upon recording completion.

Cloud Integration: Seamlessly handles Zoom’s recording.completed events to trigger downstream processing without manual user intervention.

Secure Data Pipeline: Implements Zoom’s mandatory URL validation (CRC) and encrypted token exchanges to ensure all meeting data remains private and secure.

The "Why" (The Problem it Solves)
Manually downloading, renaming, and uploading meeting transcripts is a bottleneck for teams. [Project Name] eliminates this administrative overhead, ensuring that every word spoken in a "Project Sync" or "Client Discovery" call is archived, searchable, and ready for further AI analysis or documentation.
